title: Propose Withdrawn and Rejected records: baseline and gap demos

overview.title: The ticket
overview.markdown:
Withdrawn, Withdrawn (Cascaded), Rejected and Rejected (Cascaded) records can be proposed directly, with no edit and no new version. Today the user must click Edit, which creates a draft version, then Propose.

- Server: an explicit proposable-states set plus `workflow_config` entries.
- Rejected becomes proposable only once the rejection is final.
- Archived records and records still on their approved version stay non-proposable.
- Drafts Pending: no duplicate rows; listing Rejected is an open question.

overview.title: Cucumber plan
overview.markdown: Existing scenarios in `suppliers.feature`, `control_methods.feature`, `rmp_2.feature` and `archive_6.feature` are extended for propose-after-withdraw. New scenarios cover the Drafts Pending dedupe and a rejected record with an approver still pending (7c). Guards for archived and approved-version records get their own checks.

overview.title: Playwright baseline
overview.markdown: Run on `master` against Rockets R US, project PRJ-18. Checks 1, 4 and 10 are **confirmed**: no propose from a withdrawn Supplier, bulk Propose disabled, duplicate rows in Drafts Pending. A single-record REST propose from Withdrawn already works, so the propose flag was probably off locally. Checks 2, 3, 5-9 and 11 wait for the after-run.
